description.text:
此職務會結合不同專長的人才開發能在工作環境自主移動並協同工作人員完成任務的機器人。
需要具全端開發背景並對下列一個或多個領域有興趣：
Electrical design, Mechanical design, Algorithm design, Autonomous control, Kinematics, Dynamics, Robotic Manipulation, Motion Planning, Artificial intelligence, Computer vision, Machine learning, Localization, Mapping, Navigation, Motion Control.
